FORM.notes: source note: M 是日繁雄先生, B 是風建福 (lahi' a taro' babayi) 先生 Note: Speaker M: Mr. Ri Fan-hsiung (Saisiyat name: ); Speaker B: Mr. lahi' a taro' babayi

S.FORM: M o baki' So'o mwai' ila hini' kala minayti' koza ila kin honaehnge.
S.PHON: m o βakiʔ ʃoʔo mwaiʔ ila hiniʔ kala minajtiʔ ko[z|ð]a ila kin honæhŋə
S.FORM: M o baki' So'o mwai' ila hini' kala minayti' koza ila kin honaehnge.
S.PHON: m o βakiʔ ʃoʔo mwaiʔ ila hiniʔ kala minajtiʔ ko[z|ð]a ila kin honæhŋə
S.TRANSL: 先生,你來他們這兒已經多久了?
Sir, how long have you been here?

S.FORM: B yo B mwai' rini' 'am SayboSi 'ilaS sizaeh.
S.PHON: β jo β mwaiʔ riniʔ ʔam ʃajβoʃi ʔilaʃ [s|θ]i[z|ð]æh
S.FORM: B yo B mwai' rini' 'am SayboSi 'ilaS sizaeh.
S.PHON: β jo β mwaiʔ riniʔ ʔam ʃajβoʃi ʔilaʃ [s|θ]i[z|ð]æh
S.TRANSL: 唷,我來這裡已經有六個月了.
I've been here six months already.

S.FORM: M a SayboSi 'ilas ma hoenaehnge ila ka 'am samsah ila.
S.PHON: m a ʃajβoʃi ʔila[s|θ] ma hœnæhŋə ila ka ʔam [s|θ]am[s|θ]ah ila
S.FORM: M a SayboSi 'ilas ma hoenaehnge ila ka 'am samsah ila.
S.PHON: m a ʃajβoʃi ʔila[s|θ] ma hœnæhŋə ila ka ʔam [s|θ]am[s|θ]ah ila
S.TRANSL: 啊,六個月喔,也滿久了.
Ah, six months already. It's been a long time.

S.FORM: M a mwai' hini kala minayti' M niSo' kano' patawawen.
S.PHON: m a mwaiʔ hini kala minajtiʔ m niʃoʔ kanoʔ patawawən
S.FORM: M a mwai' hini kala minayti' M niSo' kano' patawawen.
S.PHON: m a mwaiʔ hini kala minajtiʔ m niʃoʔ kanoʔ patawawən

TRANSL.notes: 那＝你來他們這裡，你做什麼事啊？

S.TRANSL: 那=你來他們這裡,你做什麼事啊?
What do you do here?

S.FORM: B o matawaw maelahaeng ka span ka wa'ae' B tabo sapeh B o B ma' 'ima kikoso'.
S.PHON: β o matawaw mælahæŋ ka [s|θ]pan ka waʔæʔ β taβo [s|θ]apəh β o β maʔ ʔima kiko[s|θ]oʔ
S.FORM: B o matawaw maelahaeng ka span ka wa'ae' B tabo sapeh B o B ma' 'ima kikoso'.
S.PHON: β o matawaw mælahæŋ ka [s|θ]pan ka waʔæʔ β taβo [s|θ]apəh β o β maʔ ʔima kiko[s|θ]oʔ
S.TRANSL: 喔,我照顧養的鹿啊,餵它們吃東西啊,打掃啊,喔還有,除草啊.
I feed the deer, sweep the place, and do the weeding too.

S.FORM: M a M koza' kasinpanan kin 'akoy.
S.PHON: m a m ko[z|ð]aʔ ka[s|θ]inpanan kin ʔakoj
S.FORM: M a M koza' kasinpanan kin 'akoy.
S.PHON: m a m ko[z|ð]aʔ ka[s|θ]inpanan kin ʔakoj
S.TRANSL: 啊,那你們養很多嗎?
How many (animals) do you raise?

S.FORM: B sinpanan kinaroSa'an B e matool.
S.PHON: β [s|θ]inpanan kinaroʃaʔan β ə matool
S.FORM: B sinpanan kinaroSa'an B e matool.
S.PHON: β [s|θ]inpanan kinaroʃaʔan β ə matool
S.TRANSL: 養在兩個地方,總共有三十隻.
They are kept in two places, thirty in all.

S.FORM: M matool B e M piza' sinraehoe' hiza koSa'en ka wa'ae'.
S.PHON: m matool β ə m pi[z|ð]aʔ [s|θ]inræhœʔ hi[z|ð]a koʃaʔən ka waʔæʔ
S.FORM: M matool B e M piza' sinraehoe' hiza koSa'en ka wa'ae'.
S.PHON: m matool β ə m pi[z|ð]aʔ [s|θ]inræhœʔ hi[z|ð]a koʃaʔən ka waʔæʔ
S.TRANSL: 三十喔.那鹿總共有幾種啊?
How many species are there?

S.FORM: B too' sinraehoe' M too' sinraehoe' M 'aehae' M koSa'en kasakiray bangol ka wa'ae'.
S.PHON: β tooʔ [s|θ]inræhœʔ m tooʔ [s|θ]inræhœʔ m ʔæhæʔ m koʃaʔən ka[s|θ]akiraj βaŋol ka waʔæʔ
S.FORM: B too' sinraehoe' M too' sinraehoe' M 'aehae' M koSa'en kasakiray bangol ka wa'ae'.
S.PHON: β tooʔ [s|θ]inræhœʔ m tooʔ [s|θ]inræhœʔ m ʔæhæʔ m koʃaʔən ka[s|θ]akiraj βaŋol ka waʔæʔ
S.TRANSL: 喔三個,三個種類.一種是野鹿.
Three. One is wild.

S.FORM: B e M 'aehae' naehaen M sinkano'on.
S.PHON: β ə m ʔæhæʔ næhæn m [s|θ]inkanoʔon
S.FORM: B e M 'aehae' naehaen M sinkano'on.
S.PHON: β ə m ʔæhæʔ næhæn m [s|θ]inkanoʔon
S.TRANSL: 另外一種是叫做什麼來的.
There is one more wachamaccalit.

S.FORM: B 'ihi' B mita' noka SaiSiyat yao kik sekela o koSa'en inak'inoan wa'a'.
S.PHON: β ʔihiʔ β mitaʔ noka ʃaiʃijat jao kik [s|θ]əkəla o koʃaʔən inakʔinoan waʔaʔ
S.FORM: B 'ihi' B mita' noka SaiSiyat yao kik sekela o koSa'en inak'inoan wa'a'.
S.PHON: β ʔihiʔ β mitaʔ noka ʃaiʃijat jao kik [s|θ]əkəla o koʃaʔən inakʔinoan waʔaʔ
S.TRANSL: 喔,我們賽夏人不知道怎麼叫那種鹿.
We don't know how to call it.

S.FORM: M ah B noka 'inaray roSa' sinraehoe 'inaray babih.
S.PHON: m ah β noka ʔinaraj roʃaʔ [s|θ]inræhœ ʔinaraj βaβih
S.FORM: M ah B noka 'inaray roSa' sinraehoe 'inaray babih.
S.PHON: m ah β noka ʔinaraj roʃaʔ [s|θ]inræhœ ʔinaraj βaβih
S.TRANSL: 另外兩個種類是來自別的地方.
Two species are from other places.

FORM.notes: source optional notation materialized from M ah B inaray kabih no(ka) wasal.; kept group(s): none; omitted group(s): 1

S.FORM: M ah B inaray kabih no wasal.
S.PHON: m ah β inaraj kaβih no wa[s|θ]al
S.FORM: M ah B inaray kabih no wasal.
S.PHON: m ah β inaraj kaβih no wa[s|θ]al
S.TRANSL: 啊,是從國外來的.
Ah, from overseas.

FORM.notes: source optional notation materialized from M ah B inaray kabih no(ka) wasal.; kept group(s): 1; omitted group(s): none

S.FORM: M ah B inaray kabih noka wasal.
S.PHON: m ah β inaraj kaβih noka wa[s|θ]al
S.FORM: M ah B inaray kabih noka wasal.
S.PHON: m ah β inaraj kaβih noka wa[s|θ]al
S.TRANSL: 啊,是從國外來的.
Ah, from overseas.

S.FORM: M ai M hiza M ra 'a wa'ae' M 'aehae' sinraehoe koSa'en kasikiray bangol.
S.PHON: m ai m hi[z|ð]a m ra ʔa waʔæʔ m ʔæhæʔ [s|θ]inræhœ koʃaʔən ka[s|θ]ikiraj βaŋol
S.FORM: M ai M hiza M ra 'a wa'ae' M 'aehae' sinraehoe koSa'en kasikiray bangol.
S.PHON: m ai m hi[z|ð]a m ra ʔa waʔæʔ m ʔæhæʔ [s|θ]inræhœ koʃaʔən ka[s|θ]ikiraj βaŋol
S.TRANSL: 是的,那一種鹿是野鹿.
Right. That is wild deer.

S.FORM: B e M 'aehae' sinraehoe' M mita' ma' 'oka' ka kapnabih ila.
S.PHON: β ə m ʔæhæʔ [s|θ]inræhœʔ m mitaʔ maʔ ʔokaʔ ka kapnaβih ila
S.FORM: B e M 'aehae' sinraehoe' M mita' ma' 'oka' ka kapnabih ila.
S.PHON: β ə m ʔæhæʔ [s|θ]inræhœʔ m mitaʔ maʔ ʔokaʔ ka kapnaβih ila
S.TRANSL: 這種鹿我們沒有名稱.
This species we do not have a name for it.

S.FORM: M mita' ma' koSa wa'ae' wa'ae' saboeh sinraehoe' M 'oka' ila o.
S.PHON: m mitaʔ maʔ koʃa waʔæʔ waʔæʔ [s|θ]aβœh [s|θ]inræhœʔ m ʔokaʔ ila o
S.FORM: M mita' ma' koSa wa'ae' wa'ae' saboeh sinraehoe' M 'oka' ila o.
S.PHON: m mitaʔ maʔ koʃa waʔæʔ waʔæʔ [s|θ]aβœh [s|θ]inræhœʔ m ʔokaʔ ila o
S.TRANSL: 我們沒有名稱,我們都叫做鹿.
We do not have names. We call all of them deer. No names.

S.FORM: M isaa 'aehae' may'isaa rpa nakhini oSa'en.
S.PHON: m i[s|θ]aa ʔæhæʔ majʔi[s|θ]aa rpa nakhini oʃaʔən
S.FORM: M isaa 'aehae' may'isaa rpa nakhini oSa'en.
S.PHON: m i[s|θ]aa ʔæhæʔ majʔi[s|θ]aa rpa nakhini oʃaʔən
S.TRANSL: 那一隻經過那裡就加入那一群的.
That one passed by there and joined the herd.

S.FORM: M kama langoy ray ralom wa'ae' hinghae' ila ki yabaka'.
S.PHON: m kama laŋoj raj ralom waʔæʔ hiŋhæʔ ila ki jaβakaʔ
S.FORM: M kama langoy ray ralom wa'ae' hinghae' ila ki yabaka'.
S.PHON: m kama laŋoj raj ralom waʔæʔ hiŋhæʔ ila ki jaβakaʔ
S.TRANSL: 那種鹿會游泳,像水牛一樣.
This kind of deer swims, like cows.

S.FORM: M o bazae'en ila komoSa' M kama langoy ray ralom M wa'ae'.
S.PHON: m o βa[z|ð]æʔən ila komoʃaʔ m kama laŋoj raj ralom m waʔæʔ
S.FORM: M o bazae'en ila komoSa' M kama langoy ray ralom M wa'ae'.
S.PHON: m o βa[z|ð]æʔən ila komoʃaʔ m kama laŋoj raj ralom m waʔæʔ
S.TRANSL: 聽說,會游泳的鹿,
It's heard that the swimming deer.

S.FORM: M o hiwa'en ka kaeh'oen.
S.PHON: m o hiwaʔən ka kæhʔœn
S.FORM: M o hiwa'en ka kaeh'oen.
S.PHON: m o hiwaʔən ka kæhʔœn
S.TRANSL: 如果鋸掉牠的角,
(If) the horn is sawed off,

S.FORM: M so M sengeen noka M pinobaeah.
S.PHON: m [s|θ]o m [s|θ]əŋəən noka m pinoβæah
S.FORM: M so M sengeen noka M pinobaeah.
S.PHON: m [s|θ]o m [s|θ]əŋəən noka m pinoβæah
S.TRANSL: 然後如果泡在酒裡,
(and) soaked in wine,

S.FORM: M o pa'oSa'en ka 'iyo'.
S.PHON: m o paʔoʃaʔən ka ʔijoʔ
S.FORM: M o pa'oSa'en ka 'iyo'.
S.PHON: m o paʔoʃaʔən ka ʔijoʔ
S.TRANSL: 加一些藥,
(and) medicine added,

S.FORM: B he M ra'oeoen noka mae'iyaeh komoSa isaza M 'am hinghae'en soiti'.
S.PHON: β hə m raʔœœn noka mæʔijæh komoʃa i[s|θ]a[z|ð]a m ʔam hiŋhæʔən [s|θ]oitiʔ
S.FORM: B he M ra'oeoen noka mae'iyaeh komoSa isaza M 'am hinghae'en soiti'.
S.PHON: β hə m raʔœœn noka mæʔijæh komoʃa i[s|θ]a[z|ð]a m ʔam hiŋhæʔən [s|θ]oitiʔ
S.TRANSL: (但是)要喝少量(一半以上就可以).
One should drink moderately (a bit more than a half).

S.FORM: M kayzaeh okik rikrika.
S.PHON: m kaj[z|ð]æh okik rikrika
S.FORM: M kayzaeh okik rikrika.
S.PHON: m kaj[z|ð]æh okik rikrika
S.TRANSL: 以免身體發燒.
to avoid (your body) heating up.

S.FORM: M o 'aehae' naehaen koSa'en kasikiray M a kokool ka wa'ae' M nakhara M ra'oeen koSa' 'am rikrika.
S.PHON: m o ʔæhæʔ næhæn koʃaʔən ka[s|θ]ikiraj m a kokool ka waʔæʔ m nakhara m raʔœən koʃaʔ ʔam rikrika
S.FORM: M o 'aehae' naehaen koSa'en kasikiray M a kokool ka wa'ae' M nakhara M ra'oeen koSa' 'am rikrika.
S.PHON: m o ʔæhæʔ næhæn koʃaʔən ka[s|θ]ikiraj m a kokool ka waʔæʔ m nakhara m raʔœən koʃaʔ ʔam rikrika
S.TRANSL: 有另外一種山鹿,那種酒喝了更熱.
Another kind of wild deer, it's hotter if you drink (that).

S.FORM: M o 'aehae' naehaen sinraehoe' isaa yao ma' M aw 'oka' ila sekela' atomalan isaa 'aehae' naehaen ka sinraehoe.
S.PHON: m o ʔæhæʔ næhæn [s|θ]inræhœʔ i[s|θ]aa jao maʔ m aw ʔokaʔ ila [s|θ]əkəlaʔ atomalan i[s|θ]aa ʔæhæʔ næhæn ka [s|θ]inræhœ
S.FORM: M o 'aehae' naehaen sinraehoe' isaa yao ma' M aw 'oka' ila sekela' atomalan isaa 'aehae' naehaen ka sinraehoe.
S.PHON: m o ʔæhæʔ næhæn [s|θ]inræhœʔ i[s|θ]aa jao maʔ m aw ʔokaʔ ila [s|θ]əkəlaʔ atomalan i[s|θ]aa ʔæhæʔ næhæn ka [s|θ]inræhœ
S.TRANSL: 有另外一種鹿我不太熟悉,
Another kind of deer I'm really not familiar with

S.FORM: B hinghae' saboeh wa'ae' koSa'en ka kaeh'oen mari'in So.
S.PHON: β hiŋhæʔ [s|θ]aβœh waʔæʔ koʃaʔən ka kæhʔœn mariʔin ʃo
S.FORM: B hinghae' saboeh wa'ae' koSa'en ka kaeh'oen mari'in So.
S.PHON: β hiŋhæʔ [s|θ]aβœh waʔæʔ koʃaʔən ka kæhʔœn mariʔin ʃo
S.TRANSL: 跟其他種鹿一樣,鋸掉牠的角,
Like all the other deer, the horn is taken,

S.FORM: B pinobaeaeh ila ka pino B pinobaeaeh ki 'iyo' ila B hiza kita' ila ka 'iyo' mita' hamez.
S.PHON: β pinoβææh ila ka pino β pinoβææh ki ʔijoʔ ila β hi[z|ð]a kitaʔ ila ka ʔijoʔ mitaʔ hamə[z|ð]
S.FORM: B pinobaeaeh ila ka pino B pinobaeaeh ki 'iyo' ila B hiza kita' ila ka 'iyo' mita' hamez.
S.PHON: β pinoβææh ila ka pino β pinoβææh ki ʔijoʔ ila β hi[z|ð]a kitaʔ ila ka ʔijoʔ mitaʔ hamə[z|ð]
S.TRANSL: 泡在酒裡,然後加一些藥,
Then soaked in wine and mixed with medicine.

S.FORM: B ka ki kita' ka mae'iyaeh B noka tatini' kasi'aelen a ka korkoring kasi'aelen B XXXX ka minkoringan kasi'aelen o 'iyo' hamez okik hinghae'.
S.PHON: β ka ki kitaʔ ka mæʔijæh β noka tatiniʔ ka[s|θ]iʔælən a ka korkoriŋ ka[s|θ]iʔælən β **** ka minkoriŋan ka[s|θ]iʔælən o ʔijoʔ hamə[z|ð] okik hiŋhæʔ
S.FORM: B ka ki kita' ka mae'iyaeh B noka tatini' kasi'aelen a ka korkoring kasi'aelen B XXXX ka minkoringan kasi'aelen o 'iyo' hamez okik hinghae'.
S.PHON: β ka ki kitaʔ ka mæʔijæh β noka tatiniʔ ka[s|θ]iʔælən a ka korkoriŋ ka[s|θ]iʔælən β **** ka minkoriŋan ka[s|θ]iʔælən o ʔijoʔ hamə[z|ð] okik hiŋhæʔ
S.TRANSL: 老人小孩可以吃,但婦女喝的藥不太一樣.
It can be taken by old people and by children. But the medicine added into women's drink is not the same.

S.FORM: M ah B so noka hiza ka kamanraan mita' B pakwa'isan ka basang mita'.
S.PHON: m ah β [s|θ]o noka hi[z|ð]a ka kamanraan mitaʔ β pakwaʔi[s|θ]an ka βa[s|θ]aŋ mitaʔ
S.FORM: M ah B so noka hiza ka kamanraan mita' B pakwa'isan ka basang mita'.
S.PHON: m ah β [s|θ]o noka hi[z|ð]a ka kamanraan mitaʔ β pakwaʔi[s|θ]an ka βa[s|θ]aŋ mitaʔ
S.TRANSL: 男性喝的藥可以使身體強壯.
The medicine mixed in men's drinks was supposed to make the body strong.

S.FORM: B mita' ma 'okik hinghae' ka 'iyo' ka pa'oSa' hamez nak'isaza.
S.PHON: β mitaʔ ma ʔokik hiŋhæʔ ka ʔijoʔ ka paʔoʃaʔ hamə[z|ð] nakʔi[s|θ]a[z|ð]a
S.FORM: B mita' ma 'okik hinghae' ka 'iyo' ka pa'oSa' hamez nak'isaza.
S.PHON: β mitaʔ ma ʔokik hiŋhæʔ ka ʔijoʔ ka paʔoʃaʔ hamə[z|ð] nakʔi[s|θ]a[z|ð]a
S.TRANSL: 那種飲料放的藥物不同.
The medicine mixed in that drink is not the same.

S.FORM: M ay M hayza' paskilkilo' ila hani.
S.PHON: m aj m haj[z|ð]aʔ pa[s|θ]kilkiloʔ ila hani
S.FORM: M ay M hayza' paskilkilo' ila hani.
S.PHON: m aj m haj[z|ð]aʔ pa[s|θ]kilkiloʔ ila hani
S.TRANSL: 啊,有一隻生了.
There's one that gave birth.

S.FORM: B 'aehae' ila kahiya'.
S.PHON: β ʔæhæʔ ila kahijaʔ
S.FORM: B 'aehae' ila kahiya'.
S.PHON: β ʔæhæʔ ila kahijaʔ
S.TRANSL: 一隻,昨天生的.
One. Yesterday.

S.FORM: M ay B paskilkilo' M paskilkilo' ila M ka M a M koSa'en M SayboSi ila ila sinpanan M ma M isa ila paskilkilo' 'aehae'.
S.PHON: m aj β pa[s|θ]kilkiloʔ m pa[s|θ]kilkiloʔ ila m ka m a m koʃaʔən m ʃajβoʃi ila ila [s|θ]inpanan m ma m i[s|θ]a ila pa[s|θ]kilkiloʔ ʔæhæʔ
S.FORM: M ay B paskilkilo' M paskilkilo' ila M ka M a M koSa'en M SayboSi ila ila sinpanan M ma M isa ila paskilkilo' 'aehae'.
S.PHON: m aj β pa[s|θ]kilkiloʔ m pa[s|θ]kilkiloʔ ila m ka m a m koʃaʔən m ʃajβoʃi ila ila [s|θ]inpanan m ma m i[s|θ]a ila pa[s|θ]kilkiloʔ ʔæhæʔ
S.TRANSL: 有一隻生了,總共有六隻了.
One gave birth to six cubs yesterday.

S.FORM: B 'ihi' M ay hiza ma' isaa kay kayzaeh atomalan koSa'en rpa ila.
S.PHON: β ʔihiʔ m aj hi[z|ð]a maʔ i[s|θ]aa kaj kaj[z|ð]æh atomalan koʃaʔən rpa ila
S.FORM: B 'ihi' M ay hiza ma' isaa kay kayzaeh atomalan koSa'en rpa ila.
S.PHON: β ʔihiʔ m aj hi[z|ð]a maʔ i[s|θ]aa kaj kaj[z|ð]æh atomalan koʃaʔən rpa ila
S.TRANSL: 若加一點藥材就很好.
It would be good to add (something).

S.FORM: B e rpa' ila ka wa'is o.
S.PHON: β ə rpaʔ ila ka waʔi[s|θ] o
S.FORM: B e rpa' ila ka wa'is o.
S.PHON: β ə rpaʔ ila ka waʔi[s|θ] o
S.TRANSL: 是啊,會讓你更強壯.
Yes, it would make you stronger.
